prob-v1.shortlist_rule: Full cached window only. Shortlisted when at most 2 replies fail or are malformed and the ranking skill (AUC of log P(UP) minus log P(DOWN) against the outcome, errors scored 0) is above 0.55 over all scored cases and above 0.50 in both halves of the origins; 0.50 is no skill whatever the market did. Python calls UP when P(UP) / (P(UP) + P(DOWN)) is at least 0.6, DOWN when at most 0.4, otherwise ABSTAIN. References (20-session return, net headline labels) are context, not targets. A shortlisted candidate becomes a replay variant; nothing is adopted from dev results.

headline-v1.shortlist_rule: Full cached window only. Each unique served headline is judged once; a case scores the sum of (P(UP) - P(DOWN)) / (P(UP) + P(DOWN) + P(ABSTAIN)) over its served headlines, 0 without news or for a failed judgment. Shortlisted when at most 2 judgments fail and the case-score AUC is above 0.55 and above the gate labels' AUC on the same cases, and above 0.50 in both halves. Python calls UP at a score of 0.5 or more, DOWN at -0.5 or less, otherwise ABSTAIN. Nothing is adopted from dev results.

pair-v1.shortlist_rule: Full cached window only. Two questions per case, rise and fall, each read as log P(YES) - log P(NO); the case score is rise minus fall. Shortlisted when at most 2 cases fail and the AUC is above 0.55 and above the gate labels' AUC on the same cases, and above 0.50 in both halves. Python calls UP at sigmoid(score) of 0.6 or more, DOWN at 0.4 or less, otherwise ABSTAIN. Nothing is adopted from dev results.
